title: Paxos footer
description: A quiet light footer under a single hairline: five narrow columns of small link groups (grey 12px heads, slate 12px links) and a newsletter on the right with a rounded email field, fine print and a bold slate pill; below, a large mark and spaced wordmark, social icons and tiny legal links. On phones the newsletter comes first, then the groups in two columns. Links fade on hover.
notes: the email form is plain markup: wire the action prop to your own endpoint
name: paxos-footer

props.name: columns
props.description: desktop columns, each holding one or more stacked groups (on phones all groups flow in two columns)

props.name: newsletter
props.type: { label: ReactNode; placeholder: string; note?: ReactNode; submit: string; action?: string | undefined; }

props.name: mark
props.description: the large mark before the wordmark (e.g. a lucide icon)

props.name: brand
props.description: the company name, set spaced and large

props.name: socials
props.type: { label: string; href: string; icon: ReactNode; }[]
